text: [js.warn] [DRAGDRAW] frame stall max=52494ms (idle — external load on this machine, e.g. builds/bundler; not your editing)
resolution: Addressed the [DRAGDRAW] 'frame stall max=52494ms' cry-wolf report. Diagnosed it is NOT a clock-mixing bug like the startup timer (both readings come from the same performance.now() in one rAF loop; the fallback is last+16 which can only yield a tiny gap). A 52s gap between animation-frame ticks is the process being suspended / the machine sleeping — performance.now() counts wall-clock across suspend, so the first tick on resume shows a multi-second jump. Reporting that as a frame stall is meaningless noise. Fix in IsoAuthor.tsx tick(): any inter-tick gap past a 4000ms ceiling is treated as a suspend/clock-jump — advance last, reschedule, and skip the watchdog for that tick (dt is already clamped to 0.05 so the sim never lurches on resume). The real <4s starvation stalls still report as before. Verified the file transforms via tools/esbuild. Not committed.
